content:
Opened #43179 to upstream RadialSchwartzMap and Function.IsRadial.

I'm not completely sure if Function.IsRadial should live in the same file as RadialSchwartzMap. I'm also not completely sure about the notation. (There's no notation in the sphere packing repo, and while I've thought about it a bit, I haven't really got any great ideas.)

I also agree that IsRadial has to be somewhere else other than Mathlib/Analysis/Distribution/SchwartzSpace. What Claude recommended me is Mathlib/Analysis/Normed/Group, and I think this is not a bad idea.
Yeah that’s what find_home gives you because that’s where the Norm class is defined. I was considering either putting it in that file or creating a new one in Analysis/Normed
Creating a new file in Analysis/Normed makes sense to me, as we similarly have a file for #Function.Even
I've created a new file for it, feedback welcome.
